scope: Later issue595 prior-art comment; not a newly recovered scheduler run or complete novelty survey.

entries.title: Cognitive Biases in Fact-Checking and Their Countermeasures: A Review
entries.source_reported_observation: 2024 review selects 39 biases and proposes 11 countermeasures and a bias-aware pipeline.
entries.inference_limit: Conceptual precedent; proposed countermeasures are not validated individual diagnoses. Sixteen bias scenarios lacked fact-checking-specific references in the review.

access_receipt.scope: Original author/institution-hosted published PDF and publisher/metadata inspected; no countermeasure efficacy experiment repeated.

entries.title: QURI RoastMyPost
entries.source_reported_observation: Public document evaluators include actual fact/fallacy plugins, version history and inline feedback.
entries.inference_limit: Pinned code establishes inspectable overlap, not accuracy, adoption or availability of a configured live model. Default profiles can be replaced by database profiles.

entries.title: Artificial Epistemics Susty Code
entries.source_reported_observation: Company advertises an epistemic pre-action protocol drawing on science, logic and value theory.
entries.inference_limit: Vendor philosophical and exclusivity claims are not independent evidence of truth, morality or efficacy.

entries.title: Claude Constitution
entries.source_reported_observation: Published behavioral training specification discusses epistemic calibration and moral/AI-status uncertainty.
entries.inference_limit: A training intention is not evidence that a model meets the norm or possesses subjective states.

entries.title: Deliberative alignment
entries.source_reported_observation: 2024 method teaches explicit reasoning over human-written safety specifications.
entries.inference_limit: Safety-policy adherence benchmarks do not certify general fact verification or psychological/ontological diagnosis.

entries.title: Symbai
entries.source_reported_observation: Official product surface offers AI debate, argument mapping and critical-thinking feedback.
entries.inference_limit: Educational marketing and third-party debate statistics do not establish this product's causal effectiveness or factual accuracy.

entries.title: Critical Inker
entries.source_reported_observation: Research prototype combines logical analysis with Socratic feedback and visual writing critique.
entries.inference_limit: Author-reported extraction/validity measurements and a small pilot are task bounded, not independent general truth assurance.

entries.title: Project APE / CRED verification study
entries.source_reported_observation: Project reports controlled error injection and human review of paper/code/data consistency findings.
entries.inference_limit: Domain and sampling bounds matter; causal validity is explicitly outside the reported verifier scope. No FAR replication executed.
